name: EntityCard
description: Firm or member profile card with logo, type, location, stats, tags and actions.
designIntent: Directory and profile lists repeat the same firm card. EntityCard keeps the identity, stats and sector tags consistent and falls back to initials when no logo exists.

props.name: entityType
props.description: Firm type, role or member category.

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo slot. Falls back to initials when omitted.

props.name: stats
props.description: Small stats such as closed deals or active mandates.

examples.title: Directory profile
examples.code:
<EntityCard
  name="Peakstone Group"
  entityType="Investment bank"
  location="New York, NY"
  stats={[
    { label: 'Closed deals', value: '60' },
    { label: 'Via Axial', value: '3' },
  ]}
  tags={['Industrials', 'Healthcare']}
  href="/members/peakstone"
/>
examples.description: A firm card with stats, tags and a profile link.

antiPatterns.title: Don't make the whole card a link with nested actions
antiPatterns.explanation: The title and footer link are the destinations; actions stay separate so controls never nest.
antiPatterns.example: // Use href for the title and footer link; put actions in the actions slot.

accessibility.implementation: The avatar fallback derives initials from the name
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide a name even when a logo is available

accessibility.implementation: Stats render as a description list
accessibility.userRequirements: Use short labels and consistent units

compositionRules.relationship: Place entity cards in a directory Grid
